regions.appearance: low-saturation warm grey-beige with faint pink-brown undertone
regions.limit: Not saturated red brick; no new tile relief/topology.
Reflections vary; no tree/sky patterns baked as actual finish. Existing window recesses only.
Use only existing frame faces; do not invent finer grids.
Some soffits appear pale/white; discrete existing exposed slab underside faces may use lighter neutral grey if distinguishable.
Exterior roof slopes/caps not directly resolved in reviewed close photos; do not infer brown or green roof.
No invented lawn or flowerbed on existing paved solid geometry.

constraints: Full color scope is contemporary-photo approximation over a mixed-evidence exterior model; never call it1985 color restoration.
Do not change locked homepage representative or original geometry/topology.
No new lettering, gold signs, plant objects, tile joints, furniture or railing geometry.
Unseen material regions stay neutral, not mirrored uncritically from south photo.
Source photographs remain private reference, not public package assets.
Actual final colored previews still require independent visual review.

north_core_addendum.visual_evidence: Tall stair core directly visible above sunken courtyard has small grey-beige/faint pink-brown tiles matching adjoining balcony surfaces. Treating high core as ground/base neutral is an incorrect semantic classification.
north_core_addendum.orientation_limit: Photo does not label compass direction; north-core attribution is a configuration-based inference using sunken courtyard and long balcony. Not every hidden core face is directly verified.
north_core_addendum.allowed_change: Restrict y > 18.8 base-neutral rule to low surfaces z <= 4.11 m; assign existing higher core surfaces to same tile proxy. No geometry change.
north_core_addendum.roof_and_unknowns: Roof slopes/caps, unseen paving and base remain neutral; no 1985-original-color claim.
